report_comment.text: NSD3 encodes a chromatin regulator with isoforms that interact with transcriptional machinery. NUTM1 encodes NUT family member 1. NSD3::NUTM1 is a recurrent NUT carcinoma fusion. Knockdown of the endogenous fusion in a patient-derived cell line induced epithelial differentiation and impaired growth, supporting a role in maintaining the undifferentiated proliferative state. In a retrospective NUT carcinoma cohort, nonthoracic BRD3/NSD3-fused tumors had better survival than nonthoracic BRD4-fused tumors; thoracic site remained an adverse feature.
